title: Building Distant Metastasis Models for HNSCC Using Machine Learning Techniques
summary: Machine-learning models predict distant metastasis in head-and-neck squamous cell carcinoma from SEER clinical data.
ai_technology: The retrospective cohort includes 31,060 cases; four algorithms are compared and ROC/accuracy results reported.
